_comment: Brands loaded from SEMA Data. display_price: which PIES price types to show shoppers, first one present wins. RET = retail, RMP = minimum advertised price (MAP), LST = list. strip_prefix: removed from the start of product names because the brand is shown separately. name_source: PIES description code to build names from (default: Title attribute, then EXT/DES/SHO/INV); with name_style 'size_last' sizes at the start are moved after the product line, and words are title-cased.
